paragraphs: R. Levi bar Laḥma, Bava Batra (15a), said: R. Ḥama bar Ḥanina said. Rosh HaShanah (29b); Zevaḥim (53, end of side b), and several statements at the end of Mo'ed Katan: bar Ḥama. Levi bar Ḥama and R. Ḥanina disagree in three matters, Ta'anit (16a). R. Levi bar Ḥama said: R. Shimon ben Lakish said, Berakhot (5, beginning of side a). Perhaps he is one person.
